info.name: Misen Companion API
info.description:
Every endpoint in PRD §5, plus the failure paths.

Set `base_url` and `token` in the collection variables. `token` is a member token minted by `scripts/provision.py`; it resolves to both a member and a household, so no request ever names a household.

Requests that capture an id into a variable are marked — run the folders in order the first time.

variable.description: must be the household's week_starts_on day
Set automatically by the first Basil request.

request.description: No auth. Caddy and the compose healthcheck both call this.
Validates the token at app launch.
Members, timezone, week_starts_on.
Absent fields are left alone; explicit null clears.
Sets used_at. NOT a delete — the row stays queryable.
The undo path for a mis-added item. 'We finished it' is PATCH used:true.

item.name: Menu
item.description: Two weeks. An empty night is the absence of a row.

request.description: Default weeks=2, matching the Menu tab.
Title is cached from Mealie. Send `title` too to skip the round trip.
Not every night needs a recipe.

item.name: Recipes
item.description: Scaling — the one recipe operation Companion owns.

request.description: Per-line status: scaled / unscaled_no_quantity / scaled_awkward.
Expect scaled_awkward on countable units.
factor 1.0, same response shape.

item.name: Shopping
item.description: A proxy over Mealie's list, plus the menu diff.

request.description: Grouped by aisle, 'Other' last.
counts still reflect the whole list, for the progress bar.
Safe to re-run: anything already listed comes back in already_listed, not added twice.

item.name: Reminders
item.description: Preference only — the notification fires on the device.

item.name: Basil
item.description: The chat proxy. `POST /generate/chat` answers with Server-Sent Events, not JSON — Postman shows the raw stream, which is the point: you can see whether the events arrive spread out or all at once. Exactly one terminal event arrives, `done` or `error`.

request.description: Starts a thread. The conversation id comes back on the first event (`event: start`); send it back as `conversation_id` to continue. 503 means the server has no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or no MCP_DOMAIN.

exec: pm.test("starts with a conversation id", () => pm.expect(body).to.include('event: start'));

request.description: Replays the stored transcript, including the tool calls, so Basil remembers what it just did. Run the request above first — it saves `conversation_id` as a collection variable.
This member's threads, newest first. Another member of the same household sees none of these — shared data, separate voices.
Text and tool names, not raw content blocks — the blocks stay server-side for replay. 404 for a thread that isn't yours.

item.name: Failure paths
item.description: Every error uses one envelope: {"error": {"code", "message"}}. `message` is written to be shown to a person.

request.description: A night needs a recipe or a name.
week_start must be the household's week_starts_on day.
Whitespace is not a message.
